title: HandiVid: A High-Quality Dataset for Hand-Driven Interactive Video Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.29693v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hand-driven egocentric interactive video generation aims to generate dynamic scenes with realistic interaction responses conditioned on hand movements and camera motion. However, existing egocentric video datasets struggle to provide scene diversity, meaningful hand-object interactions, and reliable motion annotations simultaneously. To address these limitations, we introduce HandiVid, a high-quality dataset comprising 200K curated and annotated egocentric interaction video clips for hand-driven interactive video generation. We develop a unified data processing pipeline that integrates public datasets, online videos and synthetic videos. Through video quality assessment, hand detection filtering, and multi-stage interaction validation using vision-language models (VLMs), we select high-quality video clips with meaningful hand-object interactions. translated_title: HandiVid：用于手部驱动交互式视频生成的高质量数据集
translated_abstract: 手部驱动的第一人称（自我中心）交互式视频生成旨在根据手部动作和相机运动，生成具有逼真交互响应的动态场景。然而，现有的第一人称视频数据集难以同时提供场景多样性、有意义的手部-物体交互以及可靠的运动标注。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了HandiVid，这是一个面向手部驱动交互式视频生成的高质量数据集，包含20万个经过精心筛选和标注的第一人称交互视频片段。我们开发了一个统一的数据处理流程，整合了公开数据集、在线视频和合成视频。通过视频质量评估、手部检测过滤以及基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的多阶段交互验证，我们筛选出具有有意义手部-物体交互的高质量视频片段。由于三维手部重建依赖于初始的手部检测结果，我们将SAM 3集成到……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了HandiVid数据集，包含20万个经筛选和标注的第一人称交互视频片段，通过整合多源视频并采用视频质量评估、手部检测过滤及VLM多阶段交互验证的统一处理流程，为手部驱动交互式视频生成提供了场景多样、交互有意义且运动标注可靠的高质量数据基础。
en_tdlr: HandiVid is a high-quality dataset of 200K curated and annotated egocentric interaction video clips, built through a unified pipeline integrating multi-source videos with quality assessment, hand detection filtering, and VLM-based multi-stage interaction validation, providing diverse scenes, meaningful hand-object interactions, and reliable motion annotations for hand-driven interactive video generation.
